data.description: A creature struck by a naunet's tentacle attack is infused with raw chaos, and must make a DC %1 Will save or be confused for 1 round.  Rounds of confusion dealt in this manner stack.  A creature with a chaotic component to its alignment gains a +4 bonus on saves against this effect, and creatures with the chaotic subtype are immune.  This is a mind-affecting effect.
data.name: Confusion
